channel.title: Chill Server
channel.description: Updates for Chill Server, the Mac app that runs your agents.

item.title: Chill Server 0.9.1
item.description: Chill Server no longer restarts in a loop when codex app-server cannot start (an older codex-cli, or one that cannot run under launchd): the gateway stays up, Claude sessions keep working, and the reason, with the codex version, is shown in this panel and sent to the app.

item.title: Chill Server 0.9.0
item.description: New project folders from New Chat (the Mac creates the folder under one of your project roots), markdown tables in chat, re-scanning a pairing QR code refreshes the paired Mac instead of adding a duplicate, messages no longer cut short, optional self-hosted iroh relay.

item.title: Chill Server 0.9.0
item.description: Chill Server 0.9.0. Approvals and questions now stay in the conversation on every device and survive a server restart; native push notifications for iPhone and iPad (needs approval, reply ready); a paired device can open the Mac's local dev servers (Open localhost:PORT chips, Open preview…); a Codex turn that was cut off says so instead of looking busy; the free-session trial is counted on the device, the server only displays it; the status window shows versions and how each device is connected.

item.title: Chill Server 0.8.1
item.description: Chill Server now updates itself: Check for updates… in the menu bar panel, plus an automatic daily check. This build is notarized by Apple, so it opens without the Gatekeeper warning.
